concepts.name: Тренога
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: 2D overhead horror game enemy exploration, a concept board, not an animation sheet.
Composition: landscape board with exactly TWO spacious depictions of the SAME complete creature, LEFT dormant and RIGHT awakened and braced to rush. Same body scale and anatomy in both. Both point to the TOP of the image. Flat neutral charcoal-gray background. No captions, no UI, no scenery, no painted light beams.
Projection: STRICT 90-degree orthographic plan view, see the dorsal back; every limb lies in the XY floor plane. No 3/4 or isometric view, no upright face or raised torso, no visible vertical chest. Mouth is at the anterior edge and can be read from overhead. Eyes separate from the mouth.
Style: readable non-pixel 2D hand-drawn game art, firm dark contour, broad soft-edged shading in a few restrained tones. Gray-pink living flesh, muted rose folds, occasional cool gray bone tips. Modest surface detail, matte skin. No glossy 3D, photoreal pores, purple/maroon palette, shiny shell, heavy grunge, symmetry-copying or perfect repeated features.
Individuality: maintain coherent living anatomy, but use a few purposeful differences: unequal resting angles of supports, one deeper fold, slightly different widths of paired tissue. No random extra growths, torn anatomy, injuries or universal dirt. Whole connected limbs, unclipped silhouettes. This is a new creature family, not the earlier paired-jaw bear-trap or coiled worm. It sleeps closed, light irritates it into aggressive movement; express this visually without showing a flashlight.
Subject: a low nonhumanoid with a dense teardrop-shaped muscular core and EXACTLY THREE thick jointed limbs, not six spider legs. Two gripping forelimbs attach at the front sides, one powerful rear prop attaches clearly to the blunt rear end; no separate tail. A short blunt head forms the narrow front/top edge, with TWO small dorsal sensory eyes and a short horizontal toothy mouth, not a giant central eyeball. Legs are fleshy elbows ending in broad narrow bone hooks, no hands, paws, claws with fingers or mammal feet.
LEFT: all three limbs fold close around the uneven core into an angular compact sleeping bundle, eyes sealed, mouth closed. Show where each limb attaches; one forelimb rests slightly more forward. RIGHT: same three limbs open into a directional asymmetric stance, two front limbs reach forward diagonally and rear limb compresses to launch. Head uncovered, eyes open, anterior mouth slightly gapes with a few blunt uneven teeth. The rear prop remains one limb, not two legs. Distinct front/back and a weighted body, not a radial three-point star or a smaller Stalker.

Subject: a broad LOW ground-crawling alien with a flat irregular shield-shaped mass of thick flesh, a narrow blunt anterior head and two heavy side folds of skin. NOT wings: the folds are thick muscle-bearing tissue touching the floor, no membranes stretched over finger bones, no feathers. The dorsal middle is a dense low pear-shaped core; a small toothy slit at the FRONT/top edge and TWO tiny separate eyes near the front give it a readable animal threat, without a human face. Exactly FOUR short fleshy support hooks underneath the core, visible near the front and rear edges, connected to the body.
LEFT: the side tissue gathers diagonally over its own back in overlapping UNEQUAL folds, creating an irregular compact folded bundle with a visible front seam and tucked hooks; not a circular shell or a coil. RIGHT: the same tissue unfolds laterally into a wide uneven ground-hugging kite silhouette; the narrow head pushes forward and four short hooks brace against the floor. Most of the broad shape is living muscle and folded skin, not a pair of huge tooth-bearing jaw shutters. No flight pose, petal flower, ghost cloth or ordinary stingray tail. The two sides differ gently in fold depth and edge tension.

Subject: a HEAVY low elongated wedge-shaped alien with a thick humped muscular back, narrow front, and EXACTLY FOUR short powerful jointed hook limbs. Broad rear haunches connect directly to the narrowing torso; no neck raised above the floor. A few small irregular cool-gray bone plates lie embedded in the pink dorsal ridge with living flesh BETWEEN them; plates are unequal lengths and slightly offset, NOT full armor or a turtle shell. Two small eyes at front-side recesses are distinct from an anterior sideways-opening toothed mouth. No tusks, horns, human face, animal paws, mechanical parts or literal wild boar.
LEFT: head tucked inward under the short front ridge, all four supports drawn inward; body looks dense and inactive, skin folds compressed, eyelids sealed. RIGHT: head extends toward TOP, four supports spread low with rear pair visibly loaded for a short powerful rush; mouth opens laterally in the floor plane, exposing a limited row of large teeth without a huge bear-trap gape. Same bone plates, limb count, mass and proportions as sleeping pose. One front hook rests at a different angle, and one dorsal fold is deeper; restrained individual history, not arbitrary deformation.
